title: French Beans Carrot Poriyal
equip: Nonstick wok or stainless steel skillet

items.sub: Desiccated coconut soaked in 1 tbsp warm water

steps.x: Heat the oil in the wok on medium. Add mustard seeds and wait until they pop. Add urad dal and stir 30 seconds until light golden. Add dried chilli and curry leaves.
Add the onion and cook until translucent.
Add beans, carrot, turmeric, salt and water. Stir, cover, and cook on medium-low until just tender.
Uncover, raise heat to medium and stir-fry until no liquid remains.
Add the coconut and stir 1 minute. Turn off.

notes: Start this while the curry is pressure cooking.
Keep the 5mm cut. It cooks evenly and fits a lunchbox spoon.
Storage: refrigerate airtight up to 3 days. Reheats fine in the microwave.
